board: KY-040 rotary encoder module (common 5-pin clone board: CLK, DT, SW, +, GND)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test of two clockwise clicks plus button press printing pos=2 btn=1, PCB DRC clean, footprint). Modelled as three active-low toggles (CLK and DT contacts with on-board 10k pull-ups, SW to GND); the driver decodes every CLK/DT edge with a Gray-code state table via pin IRQs, with CLK leading DT for clockwise as the module data sheet states.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://www.handsontec.com/dataspecs/module/Rotary%20Encoder.pdf (pin assignment figure and schematic, page 3: CLK, DT, SW, +, GND, 10k pull-ups on CLK/DT only), confirmed by https://lastminuteengineers.com/rotary-encoder-arduino-tutorial/
